states.dirty: Query after a didChange that shifts the referenced declaration; the result uses unsaved source and the new range.
states.close_restore: Close a dirty overlay, query the same symbol again, and verify restored disk facts or explicit missing-file behavior.
states.repeat: Repeat an unchanged request and assert deterministic content; token result IDs follow their specified policy.
states.recovery: Introduce an incomplete construct, query valid neighboring syntax, then repair it and compare with a fresh analysis.
states.unresolved: Query a missing target and assert the documented null/empty/diagnostic policy, never a guessed unrelated symbol.
states.dynamic: Known source/schema callable returning Any must not gain guessed member facts downstream.
states.missing_schema: Remove the schema and assert documented source-only behavior and controlled diagnostics.
states.stale_schema: Replace a schema and assert that removed or changed metadata no longer appears in results.
states.dependency_change: Change a defining module, then query its unopened/dirty importer and compare current facts with a fresh workspace.
states.dependency_delete: Delete or rename a dependency and assert that stale locations and diagnostics are removed.
states.cancellation: Cancel a queued request and verify that a later valid request still succeeds without publication from cancelled work.
states.stale_version: Deliver an old document version or generation and verify it cannot replace current facts.

environments.utf16: Chinese and a non-BMP character precede the target on its line; assert exact UTF-16 ranges in request and target documents.
environments.crlf: Repeat the representative range workflow with CRLF; assert line/column equivalence to LF and no carriage-return overrun.
environments.encoded_uri: Use percent-encoded Chinese, spaces, percent signs and Windows drive syntax; opened/disk sources retain one identity.
environments.client_capabilities: Minimal versus VS Code-like capabilities preserve service semantics and honor optional provider/legend negotiation.
environments.process_transport: Exercise initialize, request traffic, shutdown and exit through the real binary with deadlines and bounded frames.
